title: Loop Patterns
concept: Master the three most common loop patterns: accumulating a sum, counting matches, and finding a value.
why: Nearly every loop you'll write falls into one of a few patterns. Recognizing them helps you write loops faster and with fewer bugs.
tips: Sum pattern starts at 0; Product pattern starts at 1
Count pattern: increment when condition is met
Find pattern: start with the first element as the best so far
Most loops fit into one of these patterns — recognize them!
common_mistakes: Starting sum accumulator at 1 instead of 0
Starting product accumulator at 0 — everything becomes 0!
Forgetting to initialize the accumulator before the loop
Using `let` for the accumulator — must be `var` since it changes
